data.description:
discovered-from:LP-0MTZRM5HV0007S0V

Operator-directed change (2026-09-13): the per-mode slot counts established in LP-0MTZRM5HV0007S0V (default 3, fast 3, cheap 2) are replaced with:
- config.yaml (default/fallback): session_slot_pool_size 1
- config-fast.yaml: session_slot_pool_size 1
- config-cheap.yaml: session_slot_pool_size 3

The structure stays identical to LP-0MTZRM5HV0007S0V (single per-mode definition, no slot_schedule, standalone proxy/mode_schedule.yaml) — only the VALUES change.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: config.yaml, config-fast.yaml set session_slot_pool_size: 1; config-cheap.yaml sets session_slot_pool_size: 3; no slot_schedule block appears in any of them.
- AC2: All tests asserting per-mode slot counts are updated to the new values (test_mode_config.py, test_provider_per_slot_ctx.py, test_ctx_slot_validation.py, test_hard_routing_cap.py, test_clamp_derived_persistence.py, test_persistence_cap_modes.py, tests/test_start_proxy_mode.sh) and the full suite passes.
- AC3: Docs/comments that hardcode the old counts are updated (proxy/README.md slot table, mode.py module docstring, config comments, docs/llama-router.md, docs/dev/hard-local-routing-cap-evaluation.md).
- AC4: After the change lands on dev, restarting the proxy shows the new slot count (1 in fast/default, 3 in cheap) via /health + /llama/local/status.

## Notes
- Per-slot context derived values change: fast/default 1 slot -> per-slot cap 262144//1 - 4096 = 258048 (clamped by warm threshold where configured); cheap 3 slots -> 262144//3 - 4096 = 83285.
- test_start_proxy_mode.sh reads slot counts from the real configs (self-adapting) but hardcodes the derived per-slot thresholds: fast assertion (currently 83285) and cheap assertion (currently 126976) both need updating to 258048 and 83285 respectively.
data.title: Slot counts: default and fast -> 1 slot, cheap -> 3 slots

data.author: pi
data.comment: Completed work pushed to dev, see commit 8567bcbb. Restarted the proxy: fast mode now runs 1 slot (total_slots=1, llama-server --parallel 1); health healthy, TTS healthy. Cheap profile (config-cheap.yaml) is 3 slots and will apply on the next mode switch to cheap.
